findings.body: Both surface cases exist, but the repository test command (`forge.toml:6`) and CI (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58`) run only Python tests; neither executes these native assertions. The reported manual run proves this revision, but subsequent changes could break the button-free fallback without failing those checks. The Tasks table explicitly assigns the native plugin test job to SHIP (`plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284`), so that task should include this file when wiring automated execution.
findings.title: Later: SHIP must include the approval tests in the native test job
